title: Dashboard Settings: keep-warm duration and the "always loaded" toggle with a memory warning
goal: Dashboard Settings: keep-warm duration and the "always loaded" toggle with a memory warning
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "ollama a+b, c as option in dashboard".

Read docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md first. A Settings block in web/public/dashboard/index.html (.settings-head, .field-grid, var(--...) tokens only, no new colour) shows keep-warm duration (select), the keep loaded always toggle (off by default) with a warning that it pins the model in memory (about 16 GB for gemma4:26b) and conflicts with VMs and image runs, and the cold/warm first-token figures

Strings: the dashboard is English only today (html lang="en", no locale mechanism), so the strings are English; if a locale mechanism exists by then they get Italian forms in the same change. Keyboard and label checks; a browser check of phone width
privacy: Local Ollama only; test data is neutral and invented; no secrets; warm-up calls carry no user text.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the existing engine-provider, config and dashboard code; bounded edit plus tests. Not a measurement.
